email.body1:
Matthew, saw Sensi.AI closed a $45M Series C after 400% revenue growth and just launched its Agentic OS for home care.

Growing that fast, the RevOps bottleneck is usually signal-to-action latency: in-market accounts surface faster than the team can act on them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, turning signals into booked meetings with no rep time: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Sensi.AI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up for Sensi.AI.

Growing 400% in a year, the measurable lift usually hides in the handoff between signal and outreach, where data hygiene and slow follow-up quietly cost replies. Tighter sequencing alone tends to lift response rates 50-70%.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I'd change, and where Sensi.AI is leaking pipeline today.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for Sensi.AI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sensi.AI's reply rate likely compares to other Series-C startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matthew, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The post-raise scaling stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Sensi.AI either way.
